Pics: 
As you can seethe map is "3d" with part of  one side over the other. Diamonds and TNT traps at the middle  There are 4 monuments, each with ranging difficulty to reach. I have made a tunnel that starts at spawn and leads to each team's "stairs" that could be used to prevent oneself from getting kill farmed.
